title: This Is the Threefold Truth
print: The engraving SDAHImages 203.png (github.com/adventHymnals/SDAHImages, docs/seventh-day-adventist-hymnal/SDAHimages/203.png), read line by line on 2026-10-18. Three systems: bars 1-4, 5-8 and 9-13, as the engraving numbers them. The stanzas are lyric rows 1., 2. and 3. under bars 1-8; the refrain, marked Refrain, is bars 9-13 and ends at the final barline. hymnal.db had "Christ had died!" and "Christ has risen!" where the refrain prints "Christ has died! Christ is risen!". Each line is as the engraving prints it, its syllables joined, its punctuation kept, but where a line's `from` says it keeps the row's word.

stanzas.from: system 1, row 2., bars 2-4: the engraving prints "as-sails"; the row's "assail" is kept, the verb of "doubt and grief" (a re-engraving drops and changes words: 466 "peae", 479 "Thread")

stanzas.text: Which, if we hold it fast,
And brings us home at last.
